article.headline: Bronston scores 18, South Carolina State defeats Mid-Atlantic Christian 56-50
article.description: — Obie Bronston Jr.'s 18 points helped South Carolina State defeat Mid-Atlantic Christian 56-50 on Tuesday.
article.linkText: Bronston scores 18, South Carolina State defeats Mid-Atlantic Christian 56-50

event.description: Mid-Atlantic Christian Mustangs @ South Carolina State Bulldogs

keywords: Mid-Atlantic Christian Mustangs @ South Carolina State Bulldogs
article.story: ORANGEBURG, S.C. -- — Obie Bronston Jr.'s 18 points helped South Carolina State defeat Mid-Atlantic Christian 56-50 on Tuesday. Bronston had five rebounds for the Bulldogs (4-16, 2-2 Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference). Chris Parker added 13 points while shooting 4 of 7 from the field and 5 for 8 from the line while they also had eight rebounds. Florian Tenebay finished 5 of 10 from the field to finish with 12 points. Janus Shepherd finished with 21 points for the Mustangs, members of the United States Collegiate Athletic Association. Mid-Atlantic Christian also got nine points from Terrence Williams. Elijah Dias had six points. Up next South Carolina State hosts Maryland-Eastern Shore in its next matchup on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
